scenes.name: ONE CLOCK
lines: Four sectors of this book each set their own watch, and each gives a model-internal witness.
本书的四个战场各自校表，各自拿出一份模型内见证。
But nature does not keep one clock for gauge couplings and another for quark flavour.
可自然界不会为规范耦合备一只钟，再为夸克味混合另备一只。
So force them all onto one shared clock, with one common set of zero weights.
那就逼它们读同一只钟，共用同一组零点权重。

scenes.name: RESOLVENT CLOCK
lines: The clock is a quadratic resolvent: one operator, read at integer ticks j.
这只钟是二次预解式：同一个算子，在整数刻度 j 上读数。
Each zero height becomes a point y, and tick j reads the average of one kernel.
每个零点高度化为一点 y，第 j 拍读出一条核函数的平均值。
Higher ticks bend the kernel harder, like sharper low-pass filters.
刻度越高，核函数弯得越狠，就像越来越陡的低通滤波器。
Only zeros through three physics windows carry weight; the first is number 8359.
只有三道物理窗口齐过的零点才分得到权重；第一枚是第 8359 号。

scenes.name: FIFTH TICK BREAKS
lines: With one shared weighting, four ticks close exactly. The fifth tick breaks, at every scale.
共用同一组概率时，前四拍精确闭合；第五拍在一切尺度上断裂。
At twenty-two binary digits, every allowed clock lands one code below the reference.
按 22 位二进制读取，所有合法的钟都比参考值低一个码。
A neutral shell reweighting rescues tick five: it needs an efficiency ratio near eighteen and a half, and the shell spans one to nineteen.
中性壳重加权救回了第五拍：它要求效率倍率约 18.5，而中性壳恰好横跨 1 到 19。
Then the sixth tick is forced up, by at least 1.33 times ten to the minus eight.
可第六拍随即被迫上移，至少 1.33 × 10⁻⁸。

scenes.name: THE SEVENTH TICK
lines: Now fix those six ticks and ask about the seventh, which nobody fitted.
现在锁住这六拍（第六拍取偏移后的值），去问没有人拟合过的第七拍。
Gauss-Radau quadrature gives the sharp answer: a window two point one four trillionths wide.
高斯–拉道求积给出锐利的答案：可行窗口宽只有 2.14 × 10⁻¹²。
At thirty-five binary digits that window is one code, 4130 codes above the reference.
按 35 位二进制读取，这个窗口只占一个码，比参考码高出 4130 格。
A selector that accepts the sixth shift but reports the reference code at seven falsifies the shared clock.
若一个选择器接受第六拍的偏移，却在第七拍仍报参考码，它就证伪了这只共同钟。

scenes.name: FORTY-FOUR BITS
lines: Keep forty-four binary digits per input, and a rational certificate forces that code.
每项输入保留 44 位二进制，纯有理数证书就能锁死那个码。
Drop to forty-three, and the same seven real zeros give two different codes.
退到 43 位，同样七枚真实零点就能给出两个不同的码。
Forty-four bits is the exact threshold.
44 位正是精确门槛。

scenes.name: THREE BANDS
lines: The six ticks also squeeze the weights: over 99.931 percent sits in three narrow height bands.
这六拍还挤压了权重本身：超过 99.931% 落进三条窄高度带。
Roughly 23, 37 and 39 percent, almost nothing between, the top band from ten to the twelfth.
大约 23%、37% 与 39%，带间几乎空无一物，最高带从 10¹² 起。
Stiffen every shell edge by one part in ten million, and no reshuffling of weights hides the response drop.
把壳的每条边刚度加强千万分之一，无论怎样重排权重，都藏不住响应的下降。
The held-out quark CP invariant J comes out six point zero eight percent low.
留出的夸克 CP 不变量 J，比参考值低了 6.08%。

scenes.name: NO NAIVE SELECTOR
lines: Could a simple physical rule grow these bands without fitting?
有没有一条简单的物理法则，不靠拟合就能长出这三条带？
Power laws, Gaussian determinants, Gibbs triangle weights, short coherent walks, single-shot selectors: certificates exclude each one.
幂律、高斯行列式、吉布斯三角权、短程相干游走、单次选择器：区间证书逐一排除。
Weights pasted on from outside break at every turn.
从外面给零点贴上的权重，处处触壁。

scenes.name: TWO LEAN FLOORS
lines: Two Lean theorems sit underneath. One bounds the weight of a narrow residue band by a positive Fourier sum.
底下是两条 Lean 定理。第一条把窄剩余类频带的权重压在一个非负傅里叶和之下。
The other floors near-collision mass: the smaller the variance, the more mass must collide.
第二条给近碰撞质量垫了一块地板：方差越小，必须碰撞的质量越多。
Two equal weights at frequencies zero and one, squared: nine is at most about forty.
两个等重的频率 0 与 1，取二次卷积：9 不超过约 40。
The next chapter looks inside the shell instead.
下一章改从壳体内部找答案。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter twelve.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十二章
